title: The Cloudflare free-limit warning comes once a week, after the busy day has passed
what: HQ looks at Cloudflare's daily request count only on Monday night, for the week before. A day that runs past the free daily limit on a Tuesday stops every MettleUp app until 05:30, and HQ only says so the next Monday. Only requests are watched; other free Cloudflare limits are not.
expected: A warning on Needs you the same day the count passes 60%, early enough to switch to the paid plan before every app stops.
how_often: on any day the apps get unusually busy
fix_line: Check the day's count every few hours and warn the same day; or move to the paid plan once gyms rely on it

title: Gym server storage has no warning on Needs you, and its limit is a fixed number
what: The System page shows gym server storage against a fixed 500 MB and turns the bar red past 80%, but nothing ever reaches Needs you, so it is only seen if he opens System. The 500 MB is typed in, whatever plan the project is really on, and the page does not say what happens when it is full (the database stops taking new records).
expected: A Needs you line at 70% and 90% of the real plan limit, saying what stops when it is full.
how_often: once storage grows near the limit
fix_line: Add a storage line to Needs you and read the limit from the plan instead of a fixed number

title: Picture storage, download traffic and code-store storage are not watched anywhere in HQ
what: The System page shows only database size and Cloudflare requests. Picture storage (free limit 1 GB), download traffic from the gym server, and the build files kept in the code store (about 401 GB today) are not shown and have no warning. Nobody knows how close they are until a service stops or bills.
expected: One line each on the System page with the use against the limit, and a Needs you line near each limit.
how_often: once any of these grows near its limit
fix_line: Add picture storage, traffic and build-file storage to the System page with a warning near each limit

title: The System page's AI cost this month leaves out the AI Assistant and the English helper
what: 'AI reads this month' on the System page counts only the column-matching AI. The AI Assistant's cost (the most expensive model) and the English helper's cost are left out, so the month's AI bill shown is too low. There is no warning when the month's AI spend passes an amount, and no ceiling for all gyms together.
expected: One AI total for the month covering every AI use, with a warning on Needs you past a set amount.
how_often: every month once the AI Assistant is used
fix_line: Add the Assistant and English helper costs to the month's total and warn past a set amount
